source_quotation: Which of you shall we say doth love us most?
submitted_quotation: Which of you shall we say doth love us most?

source_quotation: As much as child e’er lov’d, or father found;
submitted_quotation: As much as child e’er lov’d, or father found;

source_quotation:
We make thee lady: to thine and Albany’s issue
Be this perpetual.
submitted_quotation:
We make thee lady: to thine and Albany’s issue
Be this perpetual.

source_quotation:
Sir, I love you more than word can wield the matter;
Dearer than eyesight, space, and liberty;
submitted_quotation:
Sir, I love you more than word can wield the matter;
Dearer than eyesight, space, and liberty;

source_quotation:
A love that makes breath poor and speech unable;
Beyond all manner of so much I love you.
submitted_quotation:
A love that makes breath poor and speech unable;

source_quotation:
That we our largest bounty may extend
Where nature doth with merit challenge.—Goneril,
Our eldest born, speak first.
